test_checkpoint_wrapper_basic: test the checkpoint_wrapper function on a basic FFN model to verify loss and gradient correctness
test_cpu_offload_memory: test the checkpoint_wrapper with cpu_offload enabled to verify GPU memory savings during activation checkpointing
test_multiin_multiout_checkpointing: test checkpoint_wrapper on a model with multiple inputs and outputs to verify correctness across configurations
test_disable_checkpointing: test the disable_checkpointing context manager to verify checkpointing can be temporarily disabled during forward and backward passes
test_checkpoint_requires_grad: test checkpoint_wrapper behavior when some model layers have requires_grad set to False to verify selective recomputation
